description: Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka - Checklist of Implementing Standards as at 31.12.2014
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the issuance of implementing standards and regulatory requirements under the Civil Aviation Act, No. 14 of 2010. It contains a checklist of mandatory standards for aviation operations, including safety requirements, compliance with international aviation annexes, and regulatory frameworks. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it deals with regulatory matters and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
